title: server: implement compile_to_kirk
description: Implement server function to compile validated requirements and EARS patterns into KirkContract format. This compiler transforms human-readable specifications into machine-enforceable contract definitions.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL compile all validated requirements to KirkContract format
THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve semantic meaning during compilation

event_driven.trigger: WHEN validated EARS patterns are submitted for compilation
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL generate equivalent KirkContract definitions

event_driven.trigger: WHEN compilation encounters an ambiguous mapping
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL request clarification before proceeding
THE SYSTEM SHALL emit the compiled KirkContract with source traceability

unwanted.condition: IF source requirements have validation errors
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT proceed with compilation
unwanted.because: compiling invalid requirements produces invalid contracts

unwanted.condition: IF compilation would lose critical requirement information
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT complete the compilation

preconditions: Input must be validated EARS patterns
KirkContract type system must be available
postconditions: Output is a valid KirkContract instance
invariants: Compilation shall be idempotent for identical inputs
Source traceability shall be maintained throughout

happy: Given validated ubiquitous EARS patterns, when compile_to_kirk runs, then a KirkContract with corresponding invariants is produced
Given validated event-driven patterns, when compile_to_kirk runs, then a KirkContract with proper trigger conditions is generated
Given validated unwanted patterns, when compile_to_kirk runs, then a KirkContract with prohibition rules is created
error: Given unvalidated input, when compile_to_kirk runs, then UNVALIDATED_INPUT error is returned
Given patterns with no KirkContract mapping, when compile_to_kirk runs, then NO_MAPPING_EXISTS error with pattern details is returned
Given circular dependency in patterns, when compile_to_kirk runs, then CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY error is returned
